Quick integration cross-check — do NOT change any files this turn. The other lanes just reported:

--- Claude B (lane polish + resilience — settings, empty/loading/error states, edge cases, and wiring up loose ends) ---
Wrote four real test files this round, all against the actual `Fieldnotes/Core/` types (not stubs), extending the existing `FieldnotesTests` target (`project.yml` already wires `Tests/` — no project file edits needed from me):

- **`BacklinkQueryTests.swift`** (12 tests) — dedup of duplicate mentions to one backlink row, backlinks disappearing when the source is deleted, `isBroken` before/after target deletion, and the nearest-surviving-anchor tap fallback (exact match, tie-break, closer-wins, no-anchors-at-all).
- **`DemoDataSeederTests.swift`** (9 tests) — exactly 3 demo entries all flagged `isDemo`, the guaranteed live backlink and guaranteed broken link actually resolve through `BacklinkQuery`, no entry ships with an empty transcript/tags/mood, `removeAll` never touches real entries or leaves orphaned children, and a full off→on→off→on cycle stays at 3-or-0, never partial.
- **`SearchRelevanceScorerTests.swift`** (15 tests) — the exact DEC-tech_specs-006 point weights: 3pt/word transcript match, +5pt contiguous phrase bonus, 5pt exact tag match (dismissed tags excluded), 4pt mood match (dismissed mood excluded), 2/1/0pt recency decay gated on a nonzero content match (a merely-recent no-match entry scores 0, not something-from-nothing), `search()` sorting and zero-score exclusion, case/punctuation insensitivity.
- **`TranscriptEditorTests.swift`** (6 tests) — `applyEdit` updates only the targeted anchor's text, anchor `id`/`sequenceIndex`/`timestamp` survive untouched, `cachedTranscriptText` recomputes correctly and skips soft-deleted anchors, `updatedAt` bumps, unknown anchor ID throws `.anchorNotFound`.

One heads up worth flagging loudly: `DemoDataSeederTests` includes a test (`test_seed_calledTwiceWithoutRemoveInBetween_doesNotDuplicateEntries`) that will currently **fail** — `DemoDataSeeder.seed()` has no existing-data guard, so calling it twice inserts 6 entries, not 3. SettingsView's toggle binding happens to never trigger this today (it only calls `seed()` when its `@Query` shows zero demo entries), but DEC-tech_specs-008 explicitly names seeder idempotency as a required CI assertion, and it's a one-line fix (early-return if demo entries already exist). `DemoDataSeeder.swift` is data_domain's file per the lane map, not mine, so I didn't touch it — flagging for the integrator or whoever's covering that lane to add the guard.

I skipped a direct `AppLaunchCoordinatorTests` — `ModelContainerFactory.make()` writes to a real on-disk App Group path rather than an injectable in-memory config, so a test would either pollute shared disk state across runs or need production code changed to accept a container override, which is out of scope for a test-only pass. `MentionAutocompleteQuery` also already has solid coverage from another lane's file that landed concurrently with mine, so I didn't duplicate it.

In at most 8 short bullets: flag interface-contract violations, duplicated work, or integration risks between your lane and theirs that the integrator must handle this iteration. If none, reply exactly: No conflicts seen.
response:
No conflicts on file ownership — the four files Claude B lists (12/9/15/6 tests) are exactly what's sitting on disk; I read them before responding and they match verbatim, so this is confirmed-same-work, not a collision.

- **Confirmed, not new:** the `DemoDataSeeder.seed()` non-idempotency bug — I found and flagged the same gap independently before seeing Claude B's report. Two lanes converging on it raises confidence it's real; integrator should get the one-line existing-demo-data guard into `DemoDataSeeder.swift` (data_domain's file) rather than let it ride as a known-red test.
- **That failing test will make `xcodebuild test` report non-green this wave.** Integrator needs to decide: accept a documented known-failure into the verification report, or get the guard fixed first. Don't let it get silently skipped/deleted to force a pass.
- **Related architecture gap, not just DemoDataSeeder:** Claude B skipped `AppLaunchCoordinatorTests` because `ModelContainerFactory.make()` has no injectable in-memory config (writes to a real on-disk App Group path). I independently skipped `RecordingController`'s interruption/route-change tests because it has no seam to seed `state` without going through real `AVAudioEngine.start()`. Same underlying pattern: core services lack test seams for their hardware/disk dependencies. Worth one consolidated note to services_utilities/data_domain rather than two separate ones.
- **No overlap on my two files** — `MentionAutocompleteQueryTests.swift` and `AutoTaggerTests.swift` aren't touched by Claude B's list, and Claude B confirms the same (didn't duplicate mention-query coverage).
- **No interface-contract violations found** — all 8 test files' calls match the actual shipped signatures in `Fieldnotes/Core/` (checked against source directly, not `interfaces.json`'s slightly-stale version — e.g. `SearchRelevanceScorer.score` actually takes an extra `fullPhrase:` param not listed in `interfaces.json`, but both lanes' tests correctly use the real signature).
